description: This file contains unit tests for the CameraHandler component, specifically validating the behavior of the isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit function and checking the correctness of the CAMERA_CLIP_MAX_RAW_BYTES constant.

classes.name: CameraHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for CameraHandler functions, verifying payload size limits and constants.

methods.name: isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit_allowsZeroAndLimit
methods.description: Test to ensure the function returns true for zero and maximum allowed payload size.

methods.name: isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit_rejectsNegativeAndTooLarge
methods.description: Test to verify the function returns false for negative values and sizes exceeding the maximum limit.

methods.name: cameraClipMaxRawBytes_matchesExpectedBudget
methods.description: Test to confirm the maximum raw bytes constant matches the expected size (18MB).
